comment: pager.c do_look() shows a farlook with putmixed(); wintty.c tty_putmixed() decodes the looked-at glyph with windows.c decode_mixed() to its one gs.showsyms[] byte unless the symset's handling is UTF8. Under IBMgraphics with SYMBOLS bytes \x85 for the dog and \x9b for the hero, whose low seven bits are control bytes, wintty.c g_putch() and recorder patch 006 capture nothing for the symbol, and the message is one byte long: the description starts in column 9, on the first display and in the ^P message history.
